Destructive pattern detected: git reset --hard
Full command: git reset --hard HEAD~1
This command is permanently blocked. Safe route: park the commits first with 'git branch backup/<desc> <ref>', then use 'git reset --keep <ref>' instead of --hard — --keep applies the same move but REFUSES (errors out) rather than clobbering when it would discard uncommitted working-tree changes, and the backup branch keeps the moved-past commits recoverable either way.
